startups.name: 50 Startups
startups.title: 50 Startups: Profit Optimization & Multiple Linear Regression
startups.description: Analyzes expenditure across R&D, Administration, and Marketing Spend with State locations (California, Florida, New York) to predict venture profit and find the most parsimonious predictive model.

boston.name: Boston Housing
boston.title: Boston Housing: Urban Economics & MEDV Valuation Explorer
boston.description: Investigates 13 socio-economic, environmental, and structural features (CRIM, RM, AGE, DIS, TAX, PTRATIO, LSTAT, etc.) across 506 Boston census tracts to predict Median House Value (MEDV) and diagnose multicollinearity.
